guide:0:0:0.text: A team that attacks while lowering enemy SP through Sinking. Choose physical Sinking for damage through Identity attacks, Sinking and Poise with Heishou, or sustained Sinking to maintain the status and rely on its damage.

guide:1:0:0.text: Lowers enemy SP while attacking and is especially strong against enemies weak to Gloom.

guide:1:0:1.text: Gloom tends to accumulate, making healing E.G.O such as [Fluid Sac](ego:0202) and [Bygone Days](ego:0807) easy to use.

guide:1:0:2.text: [Sword Sharpened with Tears](persona:0913) Rodion is the centerpiece, offering top-tier Sinking application and physical damage.

guide:2:0:0.text: **Physical Sinking**: Use individually strong Sinking Identities without focusing on maintaining the status. The most generally applicable variant.

guide:2:0:1.text: **Sinking and Poise**: The 3 Index members use both statuses. Add the strong Poise users [Heishou Pack - Si Branch](persona:0912) and [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613). Putting Si Branch first in deployment order lets the Lord's S3 call her S3.

guide:2:0:2.text: **Sustained Sinking**: Use Count-sustaining Identities and [Solemn Lament](persona:0110) Yi Sang's Butterfly to deal Sinking as Gloom damage. Strong against single bosses. For a more specialized approach, [Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104) Yi Sang releases accumulated Sinking through S3's Sinking Deluge. Extremely fragile and suited to experienced players.

guide:3:0:0.text: Sword Sharpened with Tears switches between Blessing and Despair through defense. If choosing Despair, a strong sequence is using [Rime Shank](ego:0903) to lower SP before transitioning.

guide:3:0:1.text: Echoes of the Manor is important for building Sinking Count. Butler Identities can apply it through S3.

guide:3:0:2.text: [The Index Proxy](persona:0314) is strong when deployed, but benching her enables a support passive that restores 15 SP to the ally with the lowest SP.

guide:3:0:3.text: In Regular Encounters with many ordinary enemies, [Wild Hunt](persona:0710) can easily gain bonuses through kills.

guide:4:0:0.text: Because it sharply lowers enemy SP, this team is extremely weak against enemies with SP that mainly use negative Coins.

guide:4:0:1.text: Lust resources are often scarce despite abundant Gloom, so monitor your reserves when using Lust-costing E.G.O.

guide:4:0:2.text: [Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)'s support passive lowers SP. Pairing him with Sword Sharpened with Tears, who grows stronger below 0 SP, can avoid that drawback.

metadata.description: Limbus Company Sinking team guide: attack while draining enemy SP with Sinking. Covers the physical Sinking, Sinking and Poise (with Heishou), and sustained Sinking variants, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
